about.title: Hello, I'm Anika
about.intro: I'm an illustrator working in watercolor from a sunny little studio. My days are spent painting birds, lettering joyful words, and dreaming up characters for children's stories.
about.bodyOne: I fell in love with watercolor for its happy accidents - the way colors bloom and bleed into something more alive than I planned. Birds became my favorite subject: each one has a personality waiting to be coaxed out with a few confident brushstrokes.
about.bodyTwo: Alongside my bird paintings, I letter cheerful phrases and create gentle, characterful illustrations for picture books, nurseries, and families. Every piece starts on real paper before it ever becomes a print or product.
